note: Single source of tool definitions for the local stdio server (mcp/server.py) and the planned hosted server. Keep names, descriptions and inputSchema identical in both.

tools.name: popia_scan
tools.description: Run the POPIA static scanner over a local file or directory. Returns findings as leads for review (secrets, access control, PI in code and logs, transport). Snippets are redacted. Local only.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to a repository, directory or file on this machine.

rules.description: Optional comma-separated rule ids, for example SEC-001,SEC-004.

tools.name: popia_scan_snippet
tools.description: Scan pasted code with the POPIA static scanner. The content is written to a temporary directory under the given filename, scanned, then deleted. Nothing is stored. Use when the repository is not on this machine.

filename.description: File name including extension, for example supabase/migrations/001_init.sql or src/lib/client.ts. Extension decides which rules apply.

content.description: File content to scan. Maximum 500000 characters.

tools.name: popia_site_check
tools.description: Passive check of a live website: security headers, cookies set before consent, third-party trackers, links to privacy notice, PAIA manual, cookie notice and Information Officer. Makes ordinary GET requests only. No active testing.

tools.name: popia_generate_pack
tools.description: Generate a POPIA document pack (privacy notice, ROPA, retention schedule and related drafts) from questionnaire answers. Returns file contents, and writes them to out_dir if given. Drafts need human and legal review.

answers.description: Questionnaire answers keyed by question id. See scripts/popia_pack.py load_questions().

out_dir.description: Optional directory to write the files into.

tools.name: popia_validate_sa_id
tools.description: Check whether a South African ID number is structurally valid (date, citizenship digit, Luhn). Returns only the valid flag and a masked value. Never echoes the full number. Use synthetic IDs in tests.

tools.name: popia_lookup
tools.description: Keyword search across the skill's reference files and packs. Returns the best matching sections (heading and text, capped). Use to answer what POPIA expects for a topic, with section citations.

query.description: Keywords, for example direct marketing whatsapp consent.

tools.name: popia_checklist
tools.description: Return audit checklist tables (control IDs and checks) for one POPIA area, parsed from the reference files.

tools.name: popia_breach_triage
tools.description: Deterministic s22 security compromise triage. Returns the playbook steps, severity cues matched from the description, and a pre-filled checklist. No model call. Do not paste personal information into the description.

description.description: Short description of what happened, without names, ID numbers or other personal information.
